Description

This data element identifies if the driver was speeding, and it was related to the crash as identified by law enforcement.

Notes

Prior to 2011, if no driver was present or the driver presence was unknown, then this data element was left blank. In SAS these blank values are represented by a single dot or period (.). Prior to 2013 this data element’s name was “Speed-Related.”
